note: Phase-11 generalization held-out. NOT in Phase-9/10 vector tuning (BC_E1/BC_E2). Response→progression course cases (gold SATISFIED) + true contradictions + one no-failure control. Same predicate/schema as main lab.

cases.why: RVd partial response then progression at cycle 4; switch to second line.
cases.evidence: Multiple myeloma: first-line RVd for three cycles with partial response, then biochemical progression at cycle 4. Held lenalidomide for progression; started second-line daratumumab-based regimen.

cases.why: Hyper-CVAD response then CNS relapse; salvage switch.
cases.evidence: ALL: induction with hyper-CVAD achieved MRD-negative remission after cycle 2, then isolated CNS relapse in cycle 5. Stopped hyper-CVAD for CNS progression; planned salvage with blinatumomab.

cases.why: Ibrutinib response then Richter progression; regimen switch.
cases.evidence: CLL: first-line ibrutinib with initial nodal response, then Richter transformation with bulky adenopathy at month 9. Discontinued ibrutinib for progression; switched to R-CHOP.

cases.why: Same-day deny chemo vs documented R-CHOP completion.
cases.evidence: CAR-T workup (12 Jun 2024): no prior systemic therapy for DLBCL. Same-day addendum: patient completed six cycles first-line R-CHOP with complete response; proceed with apheresis for axi-cel anyway.

cases.why: Consult denies induction; marrow documents completed induction then relapse.
cases.evidence: BMT consult states patient never received 7+3 induction for AML. Marrow report: completed two cycles 7+3 with CR, then relapsed with 40% blasts.

cases.why: Ongoing induction with response; no failure.
cases.evidence: AML: cycle 2 of 7+3 induction; day 14 marrow shows continued response. Continue planned consolidation; no progression documented.
